_comment: v2 datum bridges: per-(gauge,model) constant offset between OFS zeta (model reference) and the v2-detrended gauge (MSL), estimated from lead-0 nowcast snapshots over each model's full available range. Written to a separate datum_offsets_v2.csv so the v1 file is preserved. Select via X_OFS_DATUM_CONFIG=x_ofs_datum_bridge_config_v2.json. The 4 added models (dbofs/gomofs/sfbofs/wcofs) only have data from mid/late-2024; the original 3 (cbofs/tbofs/ngofs2) go back to 2022 — a wide window uses all available cycles per model.
